alias: AIR: Living Room Air Quality Alert & Management
description: Monitors Living Room CO2, PM2.5, and formaldehyde. Sets alert when bad, clears alert after 10 minutes of clean air.

conditions.value_template: {{ states('sensor.mt15_mt29_carbon_dioxide') | float(0) <= 1000 and states('sensor.mt15_mt29_pm2_5') | float(0) <= 25 and states('sensor.mt15_mt29_formaldehyde') | float(0) <= 0.07 and is_state('input_boolean.living_room_air_quality_alert', 'on') }}
{{ states('sensor.mt15_mt29_carbon_dioxide') | float(0) > 1200 or states('sensor.mt15_mt29_pm2_5') | float(0) > 30 or states('sensor.mt15_mt29_formaldehyde') | float(0) > 0.08 }}
{{ pm25 > 30 and not window_open_10m and states('fan.zhimi_vb4_5851_air_purifier') not in ['unavailable', 'unknown'] }}
